default.notes: A Schengen short-stay visa is required — Switzerland handles visa applications for Liechtenstein, so apply at the Swiss mission or visa centre serving your place of residence.

groups.notes: EEA free movement: EU citizens can enter with a passport or national ID card and stay without a visa, though taking up residence in Liechtenstein is quota-limited even for EEA nationals.
EFTA citizens enjoy free movement equivalent to EU citizens.

LI.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Liechtenstein citizens.

UA.notes: Visa-free with a biometric passport: 90 days in any 180-day period. Temporary protection arrangements for those fleeing the war are separate.

RU.notes: A Schengen short-stay visa is required, applied for via Swiss missions. The EU and Switzerland suspended visa facilitation with Russia; fees are higher (€90) and processing is slower.

VU.notes: The EU suspended Vanuatu’s visa waiver over its citizenship-by-investment scheme; a Schengen short-stay visa is required.
